why.B1.1: The presence of a painful rash and elevated blood glucose are highly suggestive of glucagonoma, a rare tumor of the pancreas that can cause a distinctive rash and metabolic disturbances.
Elevated blood glucose and characteristic rash with papules and plaques are consistent with glucagonoma syndrome.

The presence of an erythematous rash with papules and plaques, along with a fingerstick blood glucose reading of > 500 mg/dL, is highly suggestive of glucagonoma, a rare tumor of the pancreas that can cause a distinctive rash and severe hyperglycemia.
